info_compressionTitle: FAQ: Complete Quality, Compression & File Size Guide
info_compressionDesc:
Estimated output file sizes by compression mode:
• High Quality: Bitrate ~6 Mbps / CRF 20. Crisp & sharp visuals. Est. size: ~600-800 MB (15 min), ~1.2-1.6 GB (30 min), ~2.5-3.5 GB (1 hr).
• Balanced: Bitrate ~2.5 Mbps / CRF 26. Standard HD quality. Est. size: ~250-350 MB (15 min), ~500-700 MB (30 min), ~1-1.5 GB (1 hr).
• Ultra Small Size: Bitrate ~250 kbps / CRF 36 (Audio 64k). Maximally compressed for quota-saving and rapid uploads. Est. size: ~25-35 MB (15 min), ~55-70 MB (30 min), ~110-150 MB (1 hr).
* If using Custom Duration, file size will scale proportionally according to the specified minutes.
info_hwaccelDesc: VidMix automatically detects if your system has a dedicated GPU (Nvidia/AMD/Intel QuickSync) or relies on CPU. Using GPU makes rendering much faster.
info_musicOrderDesc: SHUFFLE (RANDOM): Every single output video will automatically get a completely different music track order using the Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm. CUSTOM ORDER: Every output video will get the exact same music order that you set manually.
guideSpectrumDesc: Automatically create audio visualizations from your music files.
guideMixerStep1: 1. Select one or multiple Videos/Photos as the base background. (Supports drag & drop)
guideMixerStep2: 2. Select one or multiple Background Music files. (Supports drag & drop)
guideMixerStep3: 3. Select the output destination folder to save the generated videos.
guideMixerStep4: 4. Configure compression quality, hardware acceleration, and output naming as desired.
guideMixerStep5: 5. Select the music shuffle setting (Random or Custom Sequence) and click 'START GENERATING'.
guideSpectrumStep1: 1. Drag & drop a music file (MP3/WAV) into the Spectrum Maker input box.
guideSpectrumStep2: 2. Select an output folder to store the rendered visualization video.
guideSpectrumStep3: 3. Configure the visualizer settings: Bar/Waveform shape, colors, and add an optional logo.
guideSpectrumStep4: 4. Preview the audio by clicking Play, adjust settings, and click 'START RENDERING'.
guideRemoveBgStep1: 1. Drag & drop a photo into the Remove BG input box.
guideRemoveBgStep2: 2. Select an output folder for the result.
guideRemoveBgStep3: 3. Click 'REMOVE BACKGROUND' and wait for the AI to process.

guideMixerStep3Desc: Specify the destination directory where rendered videos will be stored.
guideMixerStep4Desc: Choose duration presets (15m, 30m, 1h, or Custom Minutes) and desired compression quality.

guideSpectrumStep2Desc: Select Bars, Waveform, or Circular visualizer, Rainbow Running color FX, snow particles, and center logo.

guideRemoveBgStep2Desc: Use eyedropper tool to pick key color and fine-tune edge smoothing (Feather).

guideEditorStep2Desc: Add custom stylized text, animated GIF stickers, watermarks, or audio spectrums.

guideTroubleshoot1Desc: Ensure output directory name contains no special symbols and your drive has sufficient free storage.
guideTroubleshoot2Desc: VidMix automatically detects Nvidia (NVENC), AMD (AMF), or Intel (QSV). If your GPU encounters unsupported formats, it seamlessly falls back to CPU (libx264).
guideTroubleshoot3Desc: Your license is tied to your hardware Device ID. Ensure an active internet connection during initial activation.
